name: Multi-group causal TWAS (M-cTWAS)
model_likelihood: Joint linear regression of phenotype on genetically predicted molecular traits and variant genotypes; independent Gaussian errors; unit-variance predictors.
prior: Group-specific spike-and-slab effect priors; inclusion probabilities and effect variances estimated from data; optional variance sharing across selected groups.
inference_algorithm: Genome-wide EM over independent LD blocks with a single-effect approximation; final blockwise SuSiE fine-mapping using the estimated priors, allowing multiple causal effects.
estimand: Variable PIPs; gene-level aggregated PIPs; group enrichment and partition of explained heritability.
data_input: GWAS Z-scores or effect estimates and standard errors; variant LD correlation matrix; molecular-trait prediction weights; optional LD information for weight variants.
